text:
Elaine: Heads-up — putting a draft of 'stability gates + customer exemption flow' on the table. Need quick sync: onboarding criteria, canary windows, and how we let a high-value customer stay on an older pinned model for a limited time.
Sam: Onboarding criteria — do we want hard perf pass/fail or a soft warning? infra has limited slots for canaries.
Rico: From recent evals: q3-optimized-1 shows 12% latency improvement but a ~0.8 BLEU-ish drop on seq tasks vs current pinned. We can tune quant profiles.
Lena: Customer ask from ACME: they need 6 months of pin time. We promised minimal disruption. Can we formalize a paid-exemption path?
Noah: Support perspective — longer pin windows = more surface area for security/bug drift. We need an audit trail and opt-in opt-out emails.
Sam: infra constraint: canary pools are 2x smaller in EMEA region. If we do canaries by traffic slices, we may need multi-region staging.
Elaine: Proposal sketch: 1) Onboard requires performance within SLO delta (latency + cost) and no regressions on golden prompt set. 2) Default pin window = 30 days post-promotion. 3) Customer exemption = up to 90 days for enterprise contracts (documented + billing flag). 4) Auto-rollback triggers: >5% error spike or 10% drop on eval metrics.
Rico: Golden prompt set needs to be versioned per-customer optionally. We can run lightweight A/B evals during canary (scripted). Example command: ```python run_eval.py --prompts golden_v2.json --model canary --samples 200```
Lena: We should add a manual override path for customer success to extend pin with legal signoff. Also add a UI flag in Console -> Model -> Pin Exemptions.
Noah: +1 for audit. Also ask: can we auto-notify customers 14/7/1 days before exemption expires? Support can automate emails if we expose hooks.
Sam: For rollout cadence: suggest staged rollout 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 2h, 6h, 24h observation windows. If metrics stable, continue. If not, trigger safe-fallback to pinned model. Need to codify thresholds.
Elaine: Decision items for product doc: a) exact SLO deltas (latency, cost) b) golden prompt ownership c) exemption billing flow + legal template d) UI/API affordances e) telemetry invariants to track
Rico: One more: model compatibility shim for breaking tokenizer changes — small compatibility containers that translate tokens for older clients. Worth prototyping?
Sam: Implementation note: compatibility shim is doable but adds latency. Maybe only enable for exempted customers. Toggle via routing policy.
Lena: I'll draft the exemption contract clause and send to legal. Also will collect 3 enterprise asks to prioritize billing impacts.
Noah: Support will draft the email cadence + templated cancellation flow. Also want a playbook for when a customer reports quality regressions during exemption.
DeployBot: deployment:canary created for model q3-optimized-1 - route id r-6821 - started at 2026-03-20T15:02:10Z
Sam: Can we add a flag in rollout API: "customer_exemptions_allowed": true/false? Then routing can check before falling back.
Elaine: Yes — API + Console UI parity. Also add docs: "how to request exemption" with SLA expectations.
Rico: I'll run the golden set eval tonight and post numbers. If quant tuning recovers the ~0.8 drop we can be less conservative.
Elaine: Next steps: Lena -> contractual draft by Friday, Rico -> eval numbers by EOD, Sam -> design routing + thresholds PR, Noah -> support playbook draft. We'll reconvene Monday to lock launch gates. Thanks everyone :rocket:
